title: Glowing present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boxGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5a5a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c01a2a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bowGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00ffe0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#00a8a0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ribbonGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00e8d0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#00b8b0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- gift box body -->
  <rect x='18' y='42' width='64' height='46' rx='4' fill='url(#boxGrad)'/>
  <!-- box lid -->
  <rect x='14' y='32' width='72' height='14' rx='4' fill='#ff7a6a'/>
  <rect x='14' y='42' width='72' height='4' fill='#e03040'/>
  <!-- vertical ribbon on body -->
  <rect x='44' y='46' width='12' height='42' fill='url(#ribbonGrad)'/>
  <!-- ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x='44' y='32' width='12' height='14' fill='url(#ribbonGrad)'/>
  <!-- bow loops -->
  <path d='M50 30 C36 10 20 14 24 26 C27 34 40 32 50 30 Z' fill='url(#bowGrad)'/>
  <path d='M50 30 C64 10 80 14 76 26 C73 34 60 32 50 30 Z' fill='url(#bowGrad)'/>
  <!-- bow highlight edges -->
  <path d='M50 30 C40 14 26 16 27 25' fill='none' stroke='#7afff0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 30 C60 14 74 16 73 25' fill='none' stroke='#7afff0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bow knot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='5' fill='#00ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='2.4' fill='#b8fff5'/>
  <!-- ribbon tails -->
  <path d='M45 33 L38 43 L43 43 Z' fill='#00c8bc'/>
  <path d='M55 33 L62 43 L57 43 Z' fill='#00c8bc'/>
  <!-- glow sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='1.6' fill='#aafff5'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='18' r='1.6' fill='#aafff5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='1.4' fill='#aafff5'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='72' r='1.4' fill='#ffd0c0'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='74' r='1.4' fill='#ffd0c0'/>
</svg>
